items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: He had Buddy Rich, that was when Buddy just went into the navy

ctx.x: Tore it up. We were playing soft and we followed Benny Carter fifteen piece band. He had Buddy Rich, that was when Buddy just went into the navy; Buddy was on bass--I mean on drums. We stayed in Billy Berg's Swing Club for about five weeks. That's when we were broadcasting over mutual network there.
I'd love to have some of those shows.
